22. Masculine, plural, indefinite -- sons
23. Feminine, singular, definite -- the woman
24. Masculine, plural, indefinite -- prophets

**Section 3: Parsing Verbs**

36. Qal, perfect, 3ms, root: כתב -- he wrote
37. Qal, perfect, 1cs, root: שמע -- I heard
38. Qal, perfect, 1cp, root: אהב -- we loved
39. Qal, perfect, 3ms, root: ישב -- he sat
40. Qal, perfect, 2ms, root: לקח -- you took
41. Qal, perfect, 3ms, root: עמד -- he stood
42. Qal, imperfect, 3ms, root: ישב -- he will sit

44. Qal, perfect, 3ms, root: שלח -- he sent
45. Qal, perfect, 3ms, root: קרא -- he called/read
46. Qal, perfect, 3ms, root: שפט -- he judged
47. Qal, perfect, 2fs, root: ידע -- you (f) knew
48. Qal, imperfect, 3mp, root: כתב -- they will write
49. Qal, imperfect, 3mp, root: שמר -- they will keep
50. Niphal, perfect, 3ms, root: שמע -- it was heard

54. Qal, perfect, 3ms, root: נפל -- he fell
55. Qal, perfect, 1cs, root: הלך -- I walked

**Section 4: Sentence Translation**

56. The king is in the house.
57. David wrote a book.
58. The woman sat in the city.
59. A servant sent a word to the king.
60. A prophet judged the people.
61. A priest (is) in the house of the Lord.
62. The words are not in the book.
63. Peace to you, O king.
64. We heard the voice of the Lord.
65. We knew the truth.
66. Who will dwell in the heavens?
67. Moses gave the Torah to Israel.
68. You went to the city.
69. I wrote a small book.
70. There is no king in this city.
71. In the beginning God created.
72. The warrior fell in the battle.
73. I found a book in the house.
74. Eyes saw a wonderful thing.
75. The name of the prophet is great.
